title: Custom Site Redesign
seo: Rebuild and redesign a website or app
meta: Rebuild an existing site or app with a fresh interface and fast, modern code, keeping your content and addresses. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Rebuild your site or app with a fresh, faster interface
overview: We take the site or app you have and rebuild it with a cleaner look and faster code. We review what you have, agree a design direction, and build the new interface in React or Next.js with your existing content and data. You review a live preview before anything changes. Page addresses stay the same wherever possible, so people and search engines still find what they are looking for.

pkgs.blurb: A new look for the home page and the core style.
Home page and key page types rebuilt with shared components.
A full interface rebuild with forms, motion and test coverage.

faq: Will my content and URLs stay?
Yes. We carry your content over and keep page addresses wherever possible. Where an address has to change, we add a redirect.
Do you need a design from me?
No. We propose a direction based on your brand and examples you like. If you have design files, we build to them. We show you progress during the week.
Is this the same as a migration?
No. A redesign changes how the site looks and feels. A migration changes the technology underneath. We can do both in one project if you order each service.
Can you keep my current backend?
Often yes. If your site has a working backend or API, we build a new front end on top of it. We check this at the start and tell you if the old backend is holding things back.
